messages:
anna: Quick heads-up — Customer A (healthcare) pressed for streaming completions with resume/fallback and deterministic finish_reason mapping. They also want optional structured JSON chunks for downstream parsers. Need to decide scope and launch gates. SSE-only MVP vs include WS + resume?

sam: Short answer: ship SSE MVP + signed resume token. WS is useful but bigger infra + client SDK work. SSE covers most mobile/web use cases quickly.

maria: Customer will pay for resume + auditability. Their blocking asks: canonical finish_reason enum (user/cancel/timeout/error) and a final checksum to reconcile outputs. Structured JSON deltas are high value for them.

lina: Operational concern: resume implies storing request state (KV cache snapshot) or encoding it in a signed token. Storing snapshots = retention/cost + GC complexity. Signed opaque token (stateless) looks best for Private & Hosted.

sam: Draft API pattern idea: SSE delta envelope format, small JSON per event. Example:```event: delta
data: {"seq":12,"t":"delta","chunk":"..."}``` Final event:```event: finish
data: {"finish_reason":"user","seq":N,"checksum":"sha256:..."}``` Resume token: base64(signed {model,kv_hash,seq,exp}). Client calls `POST /v1/resume?token=...` to get remaining stream or final result.

anna: Proposed launch criteria (draft): 1) SSE streaming stable for 99% of traffic; 2) Signed resume token implemented + PoC docs; 3) finish_reason standardized to public enum; 4) p90 end-to-end latency <= 1.5x sync baseline for common seq lengths; 5) compliance sign-off for Private customers (PHI).

lina: Add telemetry gates: capture resumed_session_rate, resume_fail_rate. Block if resume_fail_rate > 5% or resume latency causes p95 tail spikes. Also alert if resumed_session_rate spikes unexpectedly.

maria: Add customer integration gate: require Customer A pilot integration verifying checksum mapping and resume semantics before enterprise rollout.

sam: Rough engineering scope: SSE envelope + finish_reason + signed resume token + docs = ~3 sprints (2 engs + infra). WS + multiplex + SDKs = +2 sprints.

anna: Decision (tentative): ship SSE MVP with signed resume tokens, documented JSON envelope, and telemetry. Defer WS/multiplexing to roadmap after pilot. Action items: @sam write API spec draft, @lina design token lifecycle and telemetry hooks, @maria coordinate Customer A pilot & compliance checklist. Sync Friday 10am to finalize.

dev-bot: Reminder created: channel #product-streaming — design doc due in 3 business days. :calendar: 

maria: Ack, I'll slot Customer A for a demo next week.
sam: I'll put a minimal example in the spec and a toy client snippet for resume flow.

anna: Thanks — keeping scope tight reduces risk and meets customer ask. We'll surface WS as explicit follow-up in the roadmap. :thumbsup:
